The existing resident entry now accepts prepared real cubics using the exact polynomial-discriminant = field-discriminant * index^2 identity rather than row-0 constants.
risks: This is the predeclared one-dimensional row-1 presentation path, not a generic higher-rank class-group adapter.
The upstream resident degree catalog still deliberately rejects the equation-index divisor prime 3; regenerating row 1 from its polynomial requires the full idealprimedec index-prime branch.
